extracted.intended_audience: copy editors, proofreaders, and content editors (freelance and in-house)
extracted.subtask_description: A practical, step-by-step checklist for performing thorough copy edits on documents: preparing files, doing two detailed editing passes, running consistency and cross-reference checks across the document, and finalizing the file. Focuses on spelling/grammar, style consistency, readability, acronyms, references, and formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Housekeeping / prepare document
rubrics_metrics.description: Before you turn on Track Changes, tidy up the document. Cosmetic changes like these don’t need to be recorded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do a Save As and rename the file according to your conventions. Run a set of global search-and-replace fixes (two spaces → one space; straight quotes → curly quotes; apostrophe → curly apostrophe; en dash → em dash as appropriate; double hyphen → en dash or em dash; remove spaces around en/em dashes and slashes; ensure e.g. and i.e. are formatted as e.g., and i.e.). These cosmetic fixes can be done before recording edits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-pass copyediting approach
rubrics_metrics.description: Make two passes through the document, start to finish. Read slowly and carefully the first time. Go at a reader’s pace the second time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reading at different speeds helps catch different types of errors. The first pass should be thorough for correctness; the second should target flow and readability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Track Changes and markup settings
rubrics_metrics.description: Turn on Track Changes and set view to Simple Markup before making copy edits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track changes documents all substantive edits. Simple Markup view helps you focus on content while still tracking edits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run spellcheck
rubrics_metrics.description: Run spellcheck as part of your editing workflow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use automated spellcheck early and again at the end, but don’t rely on it alone—manual review is required for context-sensitive errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix spelling, grammar, and punctuation
rubrics_metrics.description: Correct errors in spelling, grammar, and punctuation throughout the document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include standard proofreading corrections (typos, agreement, punctuation marks). Combine with style-consistency fixes where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure consistent style
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure consistent style across the document (e.g., capitalization, hyphenation, and numbers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the chosen style guide or house style consistently: capitalization rules, hyphenation patterns, number formatting (when to spell out numbers vs. use numerals), and other style points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure correct syntax and usage
rubrics_metrics.description: Confirm that sentences use correct syntax and that word usage is appropriate and precise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fix awkward constructions, incorrect prepositions, misused words, and any grammatical constructions that obscure meaning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query inconsistencies, factual errors, logic gaps, and organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify and flag inconsistencies, factual errors, gaps in logic, and organizational problems for the author or reviewer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Raise queries where facts seem wrong, where arguments lack support, or where section order/organization impedes comprehension. Use comments or queries rather than changing substantive content unilaterally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query sexist/biased language and inappropriate tone
rubrics_metrics.description: Call out language that is sexist, biased, or otherwise inappropriate in tone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag wording that could be exclusionary, offensive, or inconsistent with the intended audience/tone and recommend neutral, inclusive alternatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confirm URLs, phone numbers, and email addresses
rubrics_metrics.description: Verify that contact details and links are correct and functional.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check that URLs work, phone numbers and email addresses are accurate, and that links point to the intended pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve readability
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhance readability by reducing jargon, breaking up overly long sentences or paragraphs, and adding heads/subheads.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simplify technical language where appropriate, split dense paragraphs, and insert subheads to improve scannability and reader comprehension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhance clarity by rewording
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhance clarity by rewording awkward, convoluted, confusing, or imprecise text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rewrite sentences or phrases that obscure meaning; prefer plain language and concrete wording to improve understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhance conciseness
rubrics_metrics.description: Improve conciseness by reducing wordiness and redundancy and eliminating overuse of passive voice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cut redundant phrases, tighten sentences, and prefer active voice unless passive is required for emphasis or style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconcile acronyms
rubrics_metrics.description: Spell out acronyms at first reference; delete acronyms used only once; create or update an acronym list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If acronyms appear, ensure first-use definitions are present; remove single-use acronyms; add missing acronyms to a centralized list when one exists.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record queries using Comments
rubrics_metrics.description: Document queries and questions for the author by leaving comments in the document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use comment threads to explain why you queried a passage, provide alternatives, and track responses. Resolve comments where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Second quick pass and comment review
rubrics_metrics.description: Make a second quick pass to look for errors missed or introduced in the first pass; review and resolve comments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address issues inadvertently created by edits; resolve or remove comments you can handle before handing off the document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Horizontal quality check (consistency across sections)
rubrics_metrics.description: Skip top-to-bottom reading and instead jump between similar sections to check for consistency across the document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compare definitions, headings, repeated instructions, or recurring elements in different parts of the document to ensure they match in wording and formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check front matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Verify front-matter elements such as volume numbers and names and confirm they match headers and footers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure metadata in front matter is accurate and consistent with header/footer and other document identifiers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check cross-references
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure references to other sections, volumes, attachments, or appendices are correct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Validate that internal cross-references point to the correct items and that numbering/references update correctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check exhibits (captions, numbering, callouts)
rubrics_metrics.description: Check exhibit captions for correct capitalization/punctuation, ensure numbering is correct and consecutive, and verify each exhibit has a correctly numbered callout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm exhibits are captioned consistently and that in-text callouts reference the correct exhibit numbers and placements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examine bulleted lists for punctuation and parallelism
rubrics_metrics.description: Check that bulleted lists have correct end punctuation for the introductory sentence, correct punctuation for each item, and that items are worded in a parallel manner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fix mismatched list punctuation and rewrite list items so they follow the same grammatical structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fix the table of contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure all entries and page numbers in the table of contents are correct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify that TOC entries reflect final headings and that page numbering is accurate after edits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure consistent document formatting
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure consistent formatting across headers and footers, page and section numbering, font type and size, use of italics and boldface, margins, leading, and justification of text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the document’s style/template uniformly to avoid visual or structural inconsistencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliography and citation consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: If there’s a bibliography, check consistency of the reference list with the given style, consistency of in-text citations with that style, and agreement between citations and the reference list.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify every in-text citation appears in the reference list and that references follow the chosen citation style consistently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Turn off Track Changes and finalize
rubrics_metrics.description: After edits are complete, turn off Track Changes and finish final housekeeping steps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before delivering the file, follow final steps: turn off Track Changes (if required by workflow), run a final replace of two spaces → one space, run a final spellcheck, and do a final Save.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final automated and manual checks
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform a final automated replacement and spellcheck and save the file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run a final replace (two spaces → one space), run a final spellcheck, and save the document to complete the edit.
